scheme_name: Vadh Se Bachaye Govansh Ko Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a registered Gaushala, Nandi Shala, Kanj House, local body, Panchayati Raj institution, or other approved institution caring for cows rescued from smuggling or slaughter.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹40 per day for large cattle and ₹20 per day for small cattle, for up to one year or the custody period, whichever is shorter.
